svg.aria-label: Sluice as a workshop line. A batch of CSV from ADLS Gen2 rides a belt to the ingest press, which compacts it into a parquet block. The block slides under the SQL ledger's stamp, which merges it into a new row. The reconcile balance then compares source and destination counts until it settles level. Under each station a queue board moves a ticket from pending to claimed to done, and the portal dial shows the job's progress.
